description: Pruning of 2no. London Plane trees (T6 and T8) and 2no. Maple trees (T5 and T7), subject to Tree Preservation Order: TPO/421/11/20, by re-pollarding to previous reduction points.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The works to the 2no. London Plane trees (T6 and T8) and 2no. Maple trees (T5 and T7), subject to Tree Preservation Order: TPO/421/11/20, shall comprise only the following and must be carried out in accordance with British Standard BS3998:2010:

- Re-pollarding back to the most recent previous reduction points and the reductions are by no more than 30% of crown volume.

To prevent unnecessary loss or mutilation to the tree, in accordance with Policies DC8 and OS5 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 2 - No less than five working days' notice shall be given to the Council's Aboricultural Officer before any work commences on the trees (Telephone 07747 018778). 

In order that the Council has the opportunity to ensure that the work is carried out in accordance with Condition 1, in accordance with Policies OS5 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
